text: Cobalt Harbor performed an offline supplier assurance review for review evidence log jsonl s006205 on 2026-07-14. The evidence question was: What minimal trace proves that the control remains attributable to its owner? The service owner assembled the source facts; the vendor reviewer tested their control boundary. The review relates AC-27 to evidence set 184 and records RISK-031 as the governing risk reference. Dependency context: no upstream dependency. The source record is p03-src-006205 and this artifact is p03-full-006205. The evidence instrument was the evidence custody note; the reviewer observed that the source record separated assertion from corroboration. During challenge, a missing custodian was treated as a review failure. Review profile: the evidence set was collected during the follow-up review; the accountable owner confirmed the operating boundary; the reviewer sampled an adverse operating condition; the source fact supported acceptance with a documented caveat; the comparison used the current control objective; the evidence was retained with the decision record; the exception path was not invoked; the reviewer found no handover impact; the decision was suitable for routine monitoring; the source chronology was complete; the control claim was independently corroborated; the review boundary identified unavailable material as a limitation; the next assurance trigger is completion of the follow-up action; the disposition was communicated to the owner; the retained rationale supports repeat review; the record remains a local offline assurance artifact. Counterexample considered: A status label alone is not evidence; it must be tied to a source fact and a reviewer conclusion. Decision rule: Accept only when the source fact, accountable role, and review conclusion agree; otherwise record a follow-up disposition. Disposition: accepted with a retained review note. No Kio capability is used or required for this offline review.
